title: Mohabbat
desc: A boy and girl fall in love. Her father cannot afford the dowry being demanded. He vows to get his daughter married elsewhere.

desc: Haunted by a tragic past, a contract killer trains a teenage girl to avenge her family's murder. They work together and form a dangerous bond.
